name: updateSettings
description: Changes how people earn points and which rank changes send notifications.

notifyOnDailyChange.description: Whether a change in the top three of today's board sends a notification. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

notifyOnWeeklyChange.description: Whether a change in the top three of this week's board sends a notification. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

notifyOnMonthlyChange.description: Whether a change in the top three of this month's board sends a notification. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

notifyOnOverallChange.description: Whether a change in the top three of the overall board sends a notification. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

userEarnPoints.description: Whether people enter their own points or earn them from questionnaires. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

calculateLoyaltyPoints.description: Whether points from the loyalty feature are added. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

features.description: The questionnaires people earn points from, in order, each opening that questionnaire. Replaces the current list; leave it out to keep it, or leave it empty to remove them all.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as a choice the settings don't offer.

result.description: The settings as they are now.

notificationsFrequency.description: The boards whose top places send a notification when they change.

items.description: One board: daily, weekly, monthly or overall change.

userEarnPoints.description: How people earn points: entering them on their honor, or from questionnaires.

calculateLoyaltyPoints.description: Whether points from the loyalty feature are added.

features.description: The questionnaires people earn points from, in order.

instanceId.description: The questionnaire's id in the app.

order.description: Its place in the list, counting from 0.
